oneLiner: Split shared trip expenses instantly without touching a spreadsheet.
problem: Groups traveling together struggle to track who paid for what and end up building messy, error-prone spreadsheets to calculate who owes whom at the end of a trip.
targetUser: Friends, couples, or small groups planning trips together who want a fast, low-friction way to log and settle shared expenses.
coreFlow: Create a trip and add participants
Log an expense, select who paid and who it's split between
App auto-calculates each person's balance in real time
View simplified settlement suggestions (who pays whom)
Mark payments as settled once completed

screens.name: Trip Dashboard
screens.purpose: Show trip name, participants, and running total of expenses

screens.name: Add Expense
screens.purpose: Quickly log a cost, payer, amount, and split method

screens.name: Balances Overview
screens.purpose: Display each participant's net balance for the trip

screens.name: Settle Up
screens.purpose: Show simplified payment suggestions to close out balances

screens.name: Trip History
screens.purpose: List all past expenses with edit/delete options

outOfScope: Bank account integration or automatic payments
